Scope Summary: Remove three existing interior passage-door levers from ground-floor doors with existing predrilled holes; install three owner-supplied compatible replacement levers. Contractor removes and disposes of old levers, supplies installation consumables, and performs installation labor. No new doors, hinges, drilling, patching, painting, electrical work, or structural work.
Owner-Supplied Materials: Three compatible passage-door levers (no contractor material cost).
Location: Boise, Idaho 83702; access: easy ground-floor access, standard scheduling.

Priced Components: (1) PB-08-71-01 (Door hardware install/replace labor) × 3 doors = $210 direct labor cost for removal and installation; (2) minor-work-allowance (1 job @ $75) = shared preliminary job-support budget covering minor consumables, handling, and cleanup.

PB-08-71-01 EVIDENCE: Owner-average-cost rate from P5 Cost Database 2026.xlsx (Master sheet), verified 2026-09-11, valid through 2026-12-12. Labor-only entry rates 'door-hardware installation labor per door'; source description states consumables (fasteners, mounting hardware) are included. [NOTE: This statement contradicts the 'labor only; price materials separately' citation in the rule, creating the unresolved ambiguity cited in issues.]

minor-work-allowance (1 job @ $75) EVIDENCE: Owner-authorized job-support budget under minor-work-v1 policy. Base rate $210, shared minimum $75, 3% of labor basis capped at $750. Verified 2026-10-02, valid through 2026-12-31. Covers job supplies, handling, cleanup, and minor work not separately itemized. No embedded reserve; standard project contingency applies separately per owner policy.

VERIFICATION REQUIRED: (1) Clarify whether PB-08-71-01 consumables (fasteners, mounting hardware, lubricant) are included in the $70 per-door labor rate or whether a separate material allowance is required. (2) Confirm that removal and disposal of three existing levers is covered within the scope of PB-08-71-01 or minor-work-allowance, or price explicitly. (3) Verify that minor-work-allowance $75 budget is adequate for fasteners, lubricant, wrapping, and disposal of three lever bodies. (4) Confirm Boise area applicability of owner-average-cost PB-08-71-01 rate ($70/door).
All work on same building, ground floor; no separate buildings or upper floors.
Exclusions confirmed: new doors, hinges (as a separate complete-set product), drilling/hole enlargement, substrate patching, painting, electrical work, structural work.

To confirm: UNRESOLVED MATERIAL CONSUMABLES: Task consumables-install describes 'contractor-supplied installation consumables (fasteners, lubricant, wrap, or minor hardware per product requirements)' as required scope, but the task note incorrectly claims this is 'already priced' in remove-install-levers via PB-08-72-07 (door-hinge material set, 0.6 EA). PB-08-72-07 is a hinge-fastener product line, not passage-lever installation consumables. No positive separate line exists for removal debris disposal or lever-specific fasteners/lubricant. Scope explicitly states 'Contractor supplies normal installation consumables' and 'Remove and dispose of existing levers.' The minor-work-allowance (1 job @ $75) is labeled a shared job-support budget covering both tasks but does not itemize or confirm consumables or disposal costs.

To confirm: CONTRADICTORY EVIDENCE ON PB-08-71-01 LABOR SCOPE: The additional rule cites 'labor only; price materials separately' and states 'consumables (fasteners, mounting hardware) are included per source description.' These statements directly contradict each other. The customer assumption separately asserts 'Installation labor (PB-08-71-01) includes consumables per source: labor with consumables included.' No evidence is provided reconciling whether PB-08-71-01 is labor-only (requiring separate consumable cost) or labor-with-consumables-included. This ambiguity blocks confirmation that passage-lever consumables are fully covered.
